integrity: Finite graph enumeration independently corroborates the complete field-uniform group-theoretic proof; no external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Field-uniform bound concerns K-point automorphism groups, not group-scheme lengths.
Equality and uniqueness are asserted over the complex field; the bound holds over every field.
Dimensions greater than five, and nonperfect evolution algebras, remain outside scope.
Unindexed equivalent prior results remain a residual bibliographical risk.
title: A sharp automorphism bound in dimension five for perfect evolution algebras
